title: Huda Shaarawi
summary: Huda Shaarawi, born in 1879 near Minya, was part of a group of women who protested British rule in Egypt on 16 March 1919. In 1923 she founded the Egyptian Feminist Union and became its first president; on returning from a women's congress in Rome that year she arrived in Cairo unveiled. The union demanded votes for women and opened a clubhouse in Cairo. She died in Cairo in 1947.

uncertainty.note: Encyclopedia.com gives only the years; one source lists the founding of the union in 1923. The 1919 protest date is from Encyclopedia.com.
